gold_row.question: Is the voltage of sensor 5.0 constant over time?
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 5})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.voltage IS NOT NULL
RETURN m.time AS time, m.voltage AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
